C0663.title: Man Sentenced for Extorting Supermarkets by Hiding Near-Expiry Food Until Expired
C0663.summary: Between May and July 2024, a man surnamed Tie repeatedly hid refrigerated near-expiry products in ambient shelves across multiple supermarkets. After the items expired, he retrieved them, paid, then demanded compensation for selling expired food and filed 12315 complaints to pressure the stores. He extorted a total of 2,000 yuan over six incidents. The court sentenced him for extortion.
